standard.summary: 仅在 Anima 原生 LoRA 路线下生效。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Takes effect on the Anima native LoRA route only.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 仅在 Anima 原生 LoRA 路线下生效。DoRA 会把权重分成方向与幅度两部分来训练，通常比普通 LoRA 更接近全量微调表现。

advanced_en.principle: Only takes effect on the Anima native LoRA route. DoRA splits weights into direction and magnitude components for training, usually approaching full fine-tuning quality more closely than plain LoRA.
